_about: Registry of this style's components (SYSTEM.md): what each one is, its kind and the regexes (sig) that find it in a built index.html. scripts/components.py plan / check / add / record read and write it: history lists your reels in order, projects maps a reel id to its project folder, and each element's reels say where it was used. Empty history = nothing used yet.
_about_components: kind = hook / scene / prop / frame / transition / outro (new every reel) or emphasis / signature / house (may stay); sig = regexes on the built index.html; history = reels in order; projects = where each reel's index.html is. scripts/components.py reads and writes this file.
